# 50states.com

> > A comprehensive reference guide to US state symbols, facts, and statistics organized by state.

50states.com is a directory and reference resource providing official state designations, symbols, demographics, and cultural information across all 50 US states. The site aggregates state-specific data including flags, seals, flowers, birds, mottos, and practical resources like tax forms and city guides.

## Key Topics

- US states
- state symbols
- official designations
- state flags
- state seals
- state birds
- state flowers
- state trees
- state mottos
- state nicknames
- state abbreviations
- USPS postal codes
- state population
- state facts and trivia
- state directory

## State Symbols & Designations

- [State Flags List](https://www.50states.com/flag): State flags with images, adoption dates, and design history
- [State Seals List](https://www.50states.com/state-seals): Reference guide to official state seals with images and facts
- [Official US State Birds](https://www.50states.com/bird): Reference guide to official state birds with images and facts
- [State Flowers List](https://www.50states.com/flower.htm): Reference list of state flowers with facts and images
- [State Trees](https://www.50states.com/tree): Reference guide to state trees with botanical information
- [State Mottos List](https://www.50states.com/state-mottos): Complete list of US state mottos with Latin translations
- [State Nickname List](https://www.50states.com/nickname.htm): Complete reference list of all 50 state nicknames
- [50 U.S. State Songs](https://www.50states.com/songs): Directory of official state songs with lyrics and audio

## State Facts & Demographics

- [U.S. States Fast Facts and Trivia](https://www.50states.com/facts): State facts and trivia directory with geography and history
- [Population by State](https://www.50states.com/population-by-state): State population statistics ranked by size
- [Famous People](https://www.50states.com/bio): Directory of famous people by state of birth

## State Reference & Practical Resources

- [State Abbreviations](https://www.50states.com/abbreviations.htm): USPS postal abbreviations for all 50 US states and territories
- [2022 State Tax Forms](https://www.50states.com/tax): Directory of state tax forms and filing resources
- [United States Newspapers](https://www.50states.com/news): Directory of US newspapers by state with history and circulation
- [State Quarters](https://www.50states.com/quarter): US Mint 50 States Quarters Program details and release dates

## State Information & News

- [City Guides](https://www.50states.com/cityguides): City guides and information directory organized by state
- [Current Events News Headlines](https://www.50states.com/ce): News aggregator for current events by state
- [Team Sports in the United States](https://www.50states.com/sports): Directory of professional and college sports teams by state
